description: This file defines the AppRoutes class, which centralizes route name constants and their associated widget builders for navigation within a Flutter app. It imports necessary screen widgets and maps route names to their corresponding screens.

classes.name: AppRoutes
classes.description: A class that contains static route name constants and a map of route names to widget builders used for navigation within the Flutter app.

methods.name: routes
methods.description: A static final Map that associates route names with their corresponding widget builders for navigation.
